artworks.title: Mädel mit Honig und Obst (Girl Selling Honey and Fruit)
artworks.artist: Johann Feigel after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a young woman seated on a rock. She is positioned in a relaxed manner, with one leg bent and the other stretching forward. Her head is slightly turned to her left, and she is looking downward. The woman wears a bonnet with a wide brim that covers her hair, and her facial features are gentle and serene. She is dressed in a long dress with puffed sleeves and an apron. Nearby, there is a basket filled with fruit, likely apples, and various food items, including cheese and bread, on a piece of cloth draped over the rock. The background is plain with no discernible features.

artworks.title: Die kleine Post (The Small Post)
artworks.artist: Sebastian Mansfeld after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene involving a figure and an interaction through a window. The image depicts a person dressed in historical clothing, holding what appears to be a letter or a small package, while looking up at an individual leaning out of a window. The person in the window seems to be holding a piece of paper or an envelope. The setting consists of a textured stone or brick wall. The drawing is detailed, and the shading provides depth and texture to both the figures and the architectural background.

artworks.title: Bändelkrämer (Ribbon Seller)
artworks.artist: Quirin Mark after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing frontally. The individual wears a historical costume, including a broad-brimmed hat, a full-length coat, an elaborate garment with a fringed apron, and numerous ribbons. Their facial features include a round face and slightly curled hair peeking out from under the hat. The figure has a calm expression and carries two large, rounded objects under each arm. The clothing is detailed with a pattern and texture. The background consists of a rock and sparse vegetation.

artworks.title: Eyerweib (Egg Seller)
artworks.artist: Johann Georg Mansfeld, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing upright. She holds an egg up to one eye. The woman has detailed facial features, a cap on her hair, and wears a long-sleeved dress with an apron and a cape. Two containers filled with eggs are around her feet. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Strohhütkrämer (Straw Hat Seller)
artworks.artist: Quirin Mark, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a dynamic pose. The person is slightly hunched forward with a smiling expression, wearing a broad-brimmed hat, long coat, shirt with ornate buttons, knee-length pants, and stockings with buckled shoes. They are holding a tray filled with straw hats and other items, with a decorative cloth around their neck and a woven satchel slung over one shoulder. The background is minimal, featuring a simple ground surface with a couple of rocks.

artworks.title: Schlawack mit Fohrdecken (Slavic Mat Seller)
artworks.artist: Friedrich August Brand, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a person standing and carrying a large bundle of thatched reed mats tied with a rope. The person has a serious expression, wearing a wide-brimmed hat, a long coat, shirt, pants, and shoes. The background shows grass, a rock, and some taller grass stalks. Text in two languages is displayed at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Mausfallen! Blasbälge! (Death to Mice)
artworks.artist: Quirin Mark, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing. The individual faces slightly to the right with one leg bent. They wear an elaborate period-style outfit including a tricorn hat, a coat, knee-length pants, stockings, and shoes. The person carries wooden boards and tools on both shoulders. The background is plain, and there is rough ground under their feet. Text at the bottom reads "Mausefallen-Blasbälge" and "La mort aux rats!".

artworks.title: Küchenträger (Food Carrier)
artworks.artist: Johann Feigel, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body portrait of a person with distinct features standing in a frontal position with a slight tilt to the right. The person has short curly hair, a prominent nose, and alert eyes. They are wearing a long-sleeved coat, a tightly buttoned vest, knee-length breeches, and shoes with buckles. One arm is holding a wicker basket over their shoulder, while the other hand holds a book. There is no jewelry visible. The background is plain with a shadow beneath the person.

artworks.title: Lorberbläterkrämer (Bay Leaf Seller)
artworks.artist: Friedrich August Brand, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing. Their body is angled slightly, facing forward with their head turned to one side. They have a friendly expression, with a softly smiling face, shoulder-length wavy hair partially covered by a wide-brimmed hat, and are wearing a long coat, boots, and carrying a large sack over one shoulder. In their hands, they hold a bundle of leaves and a basket filled with foliage. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Limonienkrämerinn (Lemon Seller)
artworks.artist: Johann Georg Mansfeld, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright, facing slightly to her left. She has her head tilted slightly to her right, with a soft expression on her face. She has neatly styled hair covered by a headpiece or cap. She wears a traditional dress with a fitted bodice, ankle-length skirt, and an apron tied around her waist. She has closed-toe shoes and is holding a basket of fruit, possibly lemons, against her hip with one hand. The background is plain, with minimal shading for a surface.

artworks.title: Milchweib (Milk Seller)
artworks.artist: Johann Feigel, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing upright. She has her left hand on her hip and is holding a small jug or pot in her right hand. Her hair is covered by a cloth, and she is dressed in traditional clothing, including a skirt, an apron, and a long-sleeved top. She carries a bundle over her left shoulder. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Poine! Poine! (Cheese Curd Seller)
artworks.artist: Johann Feigel, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing full-length. He has short, dark hair, a prominent nose, and an open mouth. He is dressed in a rustic outfit and is holding a basket on his shoulder while carrying a cap or bag in his other hand. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Wälsche Würste kauft! (Sausage Seller)
artworks.artist: Carl Conti, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing next to a table. He is reaching for a string of sausages with one hand while holding another string on his forearm. The man has distinct facial features, a thin nose, a prominent chin, and a slight smile. He has wavy hair covered by a hat and is dressed in 18th-century clothing with a long coat, knee-length trousers, stockings, and buckled shoes. There is a cloth draped over one shoulder. A wicker basket filled with sausages is on the table next to him. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Strohschneider (Straw Cutter)
artworks.artist: Quirin Mark, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a three-quarter view, leaning forward while carrying a large wooden contraption on his back. He has a composed facial expression, wearing a wide-brimmed hat, a long coat, a vest, knee-length breeches, stockings, and buckled shoes. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Kauft Tinter (Ink Seller)
artworks.artist: Carl Schütz, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals within a stone-walled setting. One person is seen from the back, approaching an arched doorway. They wear a long coat, dark breeches, stockings, shoes with large bows, and a fur hat, carrying a round-bottomed bag. Facing them is another individual leaning on a wooden gate. This person has discernible facial features including a prominent nose, a curious gaze, and short, wavy hair. They wear a loose-fitting garment with open cuffs. The background consists of large, rectangular stone blocks forming the walls, and a stone floor with light and shadow play from an unspecified light source.

artworks.title: Stubenmädgen (Servant Girl)
artworks.artist: Quirin Mark, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of a standing woman in profile. She has her arms crossed in front of her and appears to be smiling slightly. She is wearing a long dress with a fitted bodice and a bonnet or headdress. The woman has neatly styled hair and wears strapped shoes. The background is plain with a simple texture, emphasizing the woman's figure.

artworks.title: Bretzenbäck (Pretzel Baker)
artworks.artist: Johann Mössmer, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. The person has one hand raised towards their mouth and the other hand holding a long stick threaded with pretzels. They have a wide-brimmed hat adorned with floral decorations, short hair, a waistcoat, long jacket, knee-length skirt, stockings, and shoes. They carry a large, basket-like structure on their back. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Schneckenweib (Snail Seller)
artworks.artist: Carl Conti, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting with her arms crossed. She has a serene expression and is wearing a cap. She is dressed in modest clothing and there are baskets filled with shellfish, a lantern, and a draped cloth around her on a wooden surface. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Nachtwächter (Night Watchman)
artworks.artist: Johann Georg Mansfeld, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing, leaning on a long halberd with both hands on the handle. He appears relaxed, with one leg slightly bent. The man has a cheerful expression, a mustache, and unruly hair under a wide-brimmed hat. He wears a long coat, knee-length pants, stockings, and shoes with buckles. The background includes a stone or pillar and a low wall in shadow. The focus is on the man's clothing and expression.

artworks.title: Cästenweib (Chestnut Seller)
artworks.artist: Friedrich August Brand, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated on a wooden bench, tending to a pot over an open fire. She is dressed in a long-sleeved dress and headscarf, with a wicker basket and kindling wood nearby.

artworks.title: Trödeljud (Jewish Peddler)
artworks.artist: Johann Georg Mansfeld, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man in profile view standing with a slight forward lean. His right hand holds a hat, while his left hand is extended with fingers spread. The man has curly hair, distinct facial features, and wears period clothing consisting of a long coat, waistcoat, knee-length breeches, stockings, and shoes with a buckle. He also wears a scarf or cravat. He stands next to a stack of bundled items with a cylindrical object in the background. The setting is plain with no other elements.

artworks.title: Wäscherinn (Laundress)
artworks.artist: Johann Feigel, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The illustration shows a woman standing with a slight smile. She wears a bonnet, a long-sleeved dress, and an apron. She carries a large, cylindrical basket on her back. A small dog stands beside her. The background is a plain surface.

artworks.title: Griechischer Kaufman (Greek Merchant)
artworks.artist: Quirin Mark, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with one hand on his hip. He is wearing a tall, soft hat and has a mustache. His outfit consists of a voluminous coat with a fur-like texture, over a layered tunic that cinches at the waist with a sash. He stands in slip-on shoes. The background of the image is plain, with subtle texture to suggest a surface. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held by the man.

artworks.title: Teppichkrämer (Textile Merchant)
artworks.artist: L. Schijtz, after Johann Christian Brand
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length portrait of a person standing. The individual is positioned facing slightly to the right, with one foot forward in a casual stance. The person has distinct facial features with a prominent nose and is wearing a hat that provides shading over the eyes. The person is dressed in a long coat that reaches down to just above the knees, with knee-length breeches, stockings, and shoes. Draped over their left shoulder and held in their left hand is a bundle of textiles or carpets, characterized by patterned designs and fringed edges. The background features a simple landscape with some branches and grass-like plants positioned to the left.
